name: Pengolahan & Analisis Data Statistika dengan Excel
description: Pengolahan data terstruktur, penerapan fungsi logika dan referensi, serta ringkasan statistik deskriptif menggunakan Microsoft Excel.
body: Proyek tugas kuliah untuk mengolah data terstruktur, menggunakan fungsi logika dan referensi, serta menyajikan ringkasan statistik deskriptif secara akurat.

name: Esai Analisis Statistika & Ekonomi
description: Penyusunan argumen berbasis data dan tinjauan analitis mengenai fenomena ekonomi dan statistika secara sistematis.
body: Esai akademik yang menyusun argumen berbasis data dan meninjau fenomena ekonomi serta statistika secara sistematis, jelas, dan mudah dipahami.

name: Komputasi & Algoritma Pemrograman dengan Python
description: Implementasi logika algoritma pemrograman dasar dan otomatisasi perhitungan matematis/statistika menggunakan bahasa Python.
body: Proyek tugas kuliah yang mengimplementasikan logika algoritma pemrograman dasar dan mengotomatisasi perhitungan matematis serta statistika menggunakan Python.

name: Statistical Data Processing & Analysis with Excel
description: Processing structured data, applying logical and reference functions, and summarizing descriptive statistics using Microsoft Excel.
body: A university project for processing structured data, using logical and reference functions, and presenting accurate descriptive statistics summaries.

name: Statistics & Economics Analysis Essay
description: Developing data-based arguments and systematic analytical reviews of economic and statistical phenomena.
body: An academic essay that develops data-based arguments and systematically, clearly, and accessibly reviews economic and statistical phenomena.

name: Programming Computation & Algorithms with Python
description: Implementing basic programming algorithm logic and automating mathematical/statistical calculations using Python.
body: A university project that implements basic programming algorithm logic and automates mathematical and statistical calculations using Python.
